verdict.rationale: Fathom documents webhooks that push each meeting's AI-generated action items to a URL of your choice. Webhooks can be created per account or via API, and an official MCP server exposes meeting data to agents. That gives an agent a documented per-meeting trigger and payload to file tasks from. However, the evidence shows no native Linear, Jira or Asana integration, so the filing step must be built by the user's agent. missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations or automations, documented action-item payload schema, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
